summary: Travis Kelce admitted on the 22 November episode of his New Heights podcast that he had been trying to delete his old "nonsense" tweets from 2010 and 2011 before they resurfaced and went viral amid his rumoured relationship with Taylor Swift. He joked about the misspelled "squirle" tweet and Jimmy Fallon's "The Ballad of Travis Kelce". The article also recaps the Kelce–Swift timeline and his WSJ Magazine comments admiring her and the media scrutiny she faces.
one_line: Travis Kelce says on his New Heights podcast that he tried deleting his old viral tweets, which resurfaced amid his Taylor Swift relationship.
key_facts: Travis Kelce, 34, said on the 22 November episode of his New Heights podcast with brother Jason Kelce that he tried to delete some of his tweets before they went viral.
The tweets from 2010 and 2011 resurfaced amid Kelce's rumoured relationship with Taylor Swift.
Kelce said "nobody followed me back then" and that he has been trying to get the tweets deleted since he got into the NFL.
Kelce said he used Twitter "like a diary" and was "just out here saying nonsense."
The fan-favourite tweet reads: "I just gave a squirle a piece of bread and it straight smashed all of it!!!! I had no idea they ate bread like that!! Haha #crazy."
Jason Kelce joked that the misspelling of "squirrel" is probably the only reason the tweet went viral.
Jimmy Fallon and his band performed "The Ballad of Travis Kelce" on The Tonight Show, with Fallon reciting Kelce's old tweets.
Another resurfaced tweet from 2010 reads: "#Chipotle will always be a great choice!!!!"
Dating speculation began in July, when Kelce said he failed to give Swift a friendship bracelet with his number during her Eras Tour show.
Swift accepted Kelce's invitation to a game at Arrowhead Stadium on 24 September and has since attended three more of his games.
Kelce attended Swift's Eras Tour show in Buenos Aires, Argentina, on 11 November, where she changed her "Karma" lyrics to mention "the guy on the Chiefs."
In a WSJ Magazine interview published on 20 November, Kelce said being around Swift has been "mind-blowing" and that he's "not running away from any of it" regarding media scrutiny.
